name: hot-corners
title: Hot Corners
description: Save presets, apply them, and toggle hot corners off and on while restoring your last layout.
author: joaogf.dev

commands.name: save-preset
commands.title: Save Hot Corners Preset
commands.subtitle: Hot Corners
commands.description: Capture the current hot corner actions and modifiers as a named preset.

commands.name: list-presets
commands.title: List Hot Corners Presets
commands.subtitle: Hot Corners
commands.description: Browse saved presets and apply one (updates Dock preferences and restarts the Dock).

commands.name: toggle-hot-corners
commands.title: Toggle Hot Corners
commands.subtitle: Hot Corners
commands.description: Turn all hot corners off or restore the last layout. The subtitle shows Enabled or Disabled for the current state.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
